Container.Name: roost
Container.Overview: An always-on home for Claude Code and Codex. Runs Claude Code's Remote Control server (drive it from claude.ai/code, the Claude mobile app or the desktop app), Codex in persistent tmux sessions, VS Code in the browser, a web terminal, a file browser, and a shared Chromium the agents can drive and you can VNC into. No Docker socket and no privileged mode: the container is the sandbox.
Container.Requires: A Claude Pro/Max (or Team/Enterprise) subscription for Remote Control. After the first start, open the WebUI; the login is "roost" and the generated password is printed in the container log (or set ROOST_PASSWORD).

Config.Name: Web UI
Config.Description: Dashboard, VS Code, terminal, files and browser (behind one login).

Config.Name: SSH
Config.Description: Key-only SSH as user roost (terminal clients, desktop app SSH connections).

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Home directory, sign-ins, browser profile, settings and logs. Delete this to reset everything.

Config.Name: Workspace
Config.Description: Projects the agents can read and write. Only map what you want them to touch.

Config.Name: Web UI password
Config.Description: Password for user 'roost' on the web UI. Leave blank to generate one (printed in the log and saved in appdata/roost/roost/secrets/web-password).

Config.Name: SSH public keys
Config.Description: Public keys allowed to SSH in (comma-separated).

Config.Name: Allow sudo
Config.Description: Let agents use sudo inside the container (apt installs etc.). It doesn't grant anything on the host.

Config.Name: Instance name
Config.Description: Prefix for Remote Control session names in the Claude apps.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID that owns files written to the workspace.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID that owns files written to the workspace.

Config.Name: Claude permission mode
Config.Description: Optional default permission mode for Remote Control sessions (e.g. acceptEdits).

Config.Name: Screen size
Config.Description: Virtual display size for the shared browser.

Config.Name: VNC password
Config.Description: Set to also open raw VNC on port 5900 for native clients (8 chars max). Blank = browser-only VNC through the web UI.

Config.Name: VNC
Config.Description: Raw VNC (only used when a VNC password is set).

Config.Name: Update CLIs on start
Config.Description: npm-update Claude Code and Codex at every start instead of waiting for a new image.
